sn45.48:1.2: sace vo bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
sn45.48:1.3: “kimatthiyaṃ āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī”ti? evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ vyākareyyātha:
sn45.48:1.5: sace pana vo bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
sn45.48:1.6: “atthi panāvuso, maggo atthi paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāyā”ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ vyākareyyātha,
sn45.48:1.7: atthi kho āvuso, maggo atthi paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāyāti:
sn45.48:1.8: katamo ca bhikkhave, maggo katamā paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāya,
sn45.48:1.11: ayaṃ bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāyāti.
sn45.48:1.12: evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ vyākareyyāthāti.
